accessibility.title: Voice guidance
accessibility.body: Voice guidance is available for this menu. It can read the selected item and the available actions aloud.
accessibility.objective: Press X to enable voice guidance for later. Press A to continue without it.
accessibility.enabled_announcement: Voice guidance enabled for later. Press A to continue.
accessibility.already_enabled_announcement: Voice guidance is already enabled for later.
accessibility.disabled_announcement: Voice guidance disabled. Animalese sounds are active.
accessibility.text_actions: A to continue. B to skip this step. Plus to skip everything.

accessibility_settings.title: Accessibility settings
accessibility_settings.body: Accessibility options are available in Settings, then Accessibility. You can adjust speech speed, repeated hints, location announcements, and position details.

welcome.title: Welcome to SwitchU
welcome.body: SwitchU replaces the HOME menu with a fast interface for launching your games, homebrew apps, and system tools.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.body: You can navigate with the directional pad, left stick, or right stick. Try one horizontal direction and one vertical direction.
navigation.objective: Try left or right, then up or down.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.body: The A button confirms an action, launches a game, or opens the selected item.
confirm.objective: Press A to validate this step.

themes.title: Themes
themes.body: Themes can change colors, images, and sounds. Open Themes from the sidebar to install or apply a style.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.body: You can use the virtual cursor with stick clicks when an action needs a pointer. Click the left stick to enable it, or the right stick to recenter it.

support.title: Support
support.body: To report an issue, open the project GitHub: github.com/PoloNX/SwitchU

system.clock_12h_desc: Show the home clock with AM and PM.
system.usb30_desc: Enable USB 3.0 for faster transfer speeds.
system.default_profile_desc: Launch games with this profile when possible.

accessibility.voice_desc: Read focused items and available actions aloud.
accessibility.voice_language_desc: Follows the current system or UI language.
accessibility.speech_rate_desc: Adjust how fast voice guidance speaks.
accessibility.speak_hints_desc: Announce available actions after the selected item.
accessibility.repeat_context_desc: Repeat the current area on every focus move instead of only when it changes.
accessibility.speak_position_desc: Announce row, column, and item position when available.

audio.hdmi_rgb_range_desc: Full for PC monitors, Limited for most TVs.

display.burn_in_desc: Reduce screen burn-in during long usage.
display.tv_screen_size_desc: Adjust overscan so the full image is visible.
display.album_storage_desc: Where screenshots and videos are saved.
display.ui_wireframe_desc: Show outlines of all Box widgets for layout debugging.

internet.auto_app_download_desc: Automatically download updates for installed games.

controllers.test_desc: Test joysticks, buttons, and the touch screen.
controllers.pairing_desc: Pair controllers and change their player order.
controllers.remapping_desc: Open the system controller button mapping tool.
controllers.usb_wired_desc: Use USB wired mode to reduce latency on compatible controllers.

sleep.docked_desc: Idle delay before automatic sleep while docked.
sleep.media_sleep_desc: Allow the console to auto-sleep even during media playback.
sleep.wake_power_desc: Wake the console when the AC adapter is connected or disconnected.

storage.uninstall_game_desc: Permanently delete the selected title from the system.
